Definition: figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. practise magic
BiblicalUsage: 1) (Piel) to make appear, produce, bring (clouds); 2) (Poel) to practise soothsaying, conjure; 2a) to observe times, practice soothsaying or spiritism or magic or augury or witchcraft; 2b) soothsayer, enchanter, sorceress, diviner, fortuneteller, barbarian, Meonenim (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
